days.meaning: 点を使って場所や分布を表す
days.idea: 北海道を題材とした3作品を公開。点描、駅の時系列、雪の暦を、それぞれ別の点表現で制作。

projects.title: 何点で分かる？
projects.description: 北海道の海岸線を、点から少しずつ。形を見分ける手がかりを探す。

en.title: How Many Points?
en.description: Reveal Hokkaido’s coastline one point at a time. Discover the shapes that help us recognize a place.

projects.title: 駅のあった北海道
projects.description: 1950–2025年。開業、改称、廃止をたどる、北海道の駅の時間地図。

en.title: Where the Stations Were
en.description: Trace the opening, renaming, and closure of Hokkaido’s railway stations from 1950 to 2025.

projects.title: 冬は、北から来る？
projects.description: 北海道22地点の初雪・積雪・根雪を、季節の暦で見比べる。

en.title: Does Winter Come from the North?
en.description: Compare the first snow, snow cover, and lasting winter snow at 22 observation sites across Hokkaido.

en.meaning: Use points to reveal places, patterns, and distributions.
en.idea: Three published experiments with Hokkaido: a coastline revealed by points, railway stations through time, and the seasonal arrival of snow.

days.meaning: 線でつながり・経路・流れなどを描く
days.idea: bonds：日本全国の姉妹・友好・交流都市。公開アプリとREADMEを確認済み。

projects.title: この線のはじまり
projects.description: 日本と世界、街と街。姉妹・友好都市を結ぶ線と、その由来をたどる。

en.title: Where These Lines Began
en.description: City to city, Japan to the world. Follow sister-city connections and the stories behind them.

en.meaning: Draw connections, routes, and flows with lines.
en.idea: Bonds: sister, friendship, and exchange-city connections within Japan and around the world. The live app and repository documentation have been checked.

days.meaning: 面・区域・輪郭を使って表現する
days.idea: cutout：街の建物フットプリントを行政界で切り抜いて3D表示。公開アプリとREADMEを確認済み。

projects.title: まちの型抜き
projects.description: 街の建物を別の街の形で切り抜く。行政界で遊ぶ、3Dの型抜き。

en.title: City Cutout
en.description: Cut one city’s buildings into the shape of another. Play with administrative boundaries in 3D.

en.meaning: Explore areas, boundaries, and shapes.
en.idea: City Cutout: clip building footprints with a municipality-shaped cutter, then extrude the result in 3D. The live app and documentation have been checked.

days.meaning: 密集やまとまり、集まるものを描く
days.idea: 採用・公開済み。北海道の観光資源を地理的距離でクラスタリングするShabon Hokkaido。実際の交通アクセスや回遊実績とは区別する。

projects.title: Shabon Hokkaido
projects.description: どこまでが近所？ 距離を変えると、観光地のまとまりがくっつき、分かれる。
projects.thumbnailAlt: Shabon Hokkaidoの実際のアプリ画面

en.title: Shabon Hokkaido
en.description: How near is near? Adjust the distance and watch clusters of tourism resources merge and separate.

en.meaning: Map concentrations, groups, and things that gather together.
en.idea: Published: Shabon Hokkaido groups tourism resources by geographic distance. These groups do not represent actual transport access or observed visitor journeys.

days.meaning: 視覚。何が、どこから、どう見えるか
days.idea: 採用・公開済み。2021年社会生活基本調査の映画鑑賞の行動者率を比較。視聴時間ではなく、コロナ禍を含む過去1年間の活動。

projects.title: 映画を見る、日本を見る。
projects.description: 映画館と、それ以外。47都道府県の映画鑑賞の地域差を比べる。
projects.thumbnailAlt: 映画を見る、日本を見る。の実際のアプリ画面

en.title: Watching Movies, Seeing Japan
en.description: At cinemas, and elsewhere. Compare movie-viewing participation across Japan’s 47 prefectures.
en.thumbnailAlt: Screenshot of Watching Movies, Seeing Japan

en.meaning: Explore sight: what we see, where we see it, and how.
en.idea: Published: compare movie-viewing participation rates from the 2021 Survey on Time Use and Leisure Activities. These are participation rates, not viewing time, and cover a pandemic-era period.

days.meaning: 古地図風の表現、または昔を題材にする
days.idea: 採用・公開済み。1987年5月21日のLandsat 5 TM画像を採用。最新READMEでは画像取得・RGB生成・候補比較の完了を確認。以前のUSGS登録メール待ちの記録は過去の状態。

projects.title: TOKYO MAP
projects.description: 1987年の衛星画像を、80年代の架空のカルチャー誌として眺める。
projects.thumbnailAlt: TOKYO MAPの実際のアプリ画面

en.title: TOKYO MAP
en.description: Explore 1987 satellite imagery through the pages of an imaginary 1980s culture magazine.

en.meaning: Create a vintage look, or map a subject from the past.
en.idea: Published: an imaginary 1980s culture magazine built around Landsat 5 TM imagery acquired on 21 May 1987. Image retrieval, candidate comparison, and RGB processing are documented in the repository.

days.meaning: 10分以内に地図を完成させる
days.idea: 採用・制作中。M5StickC Plus＋MiniEncoderCをBLEでブラウザへ接続。ファームウェアとWebアプリのREADMEあり。実機確認・10分制作の実演状況は未確認。

projects.title: MapWand
projects.description: 回して、押して、10分で地図をつくる魔法の道具。

en.title: MapWand
en.description: Turn it. Push it. Make a map in ten minutes with a pocket-sized mapping wand.

en.meaning: Complete a map in no more than ten minutes.
en.idea: In progress: a M5StickC Plus and MiniEncoderC connect to the browser over BLE. Web app and firmware instructions are available; hardware verification and a ten-minute demonstration have not been confirmed.

days.meaning: 理想郷や、あり得る世界を描く
days.idea: 追加候補「理想の暮らしができそうな町」。LINKS空き家ファインダー・共通データ基盤を利用し、農地付き・古民家など希望条件に合う掲載物件を自治体単位で集計して表示。住みやすさ自体の評価とは区別。未採用・先行制作のため優先検討。

en.meaning: Map an ideal world, or a world that could exist.
en.idea: Candidate: find towns with listed vacant homes matching an imagined lifestyle, using the LINKS housing data. Aggregate listings by municipality; do not interpret this as a measure of livability. Not yet selected.

days.meaning: 都市と農村、その違いやつながりを描く
days.idea: パラグアイ：街から農地、そして森へ。INE人口統計＋MapBiomas土地被覆。候補 追加候補：LINKSの農業ドローン活用・測量点検需要から、用途構成を二変量の色で表示。都市・農村の比較には人口密度等を別途組み合わせる。両案とも未採用。

en.meaning: Explore cities, countryside, and their connections.
en.idea: Candidates: explore the transition from Paraguayan cities to farmland and forests using INE population statistics and MapBiomas land cover; or compare drone-use patterns with population density using LINKS. Neither is selected.

days.meaning: プロンプトでAIに指示し、最初から最後まで地図を作る
days.idea: 未検討

en.meaning: Create a map from start to finish by prompting AI.
en.idea: An idea has not been selected yet.

days.meaning: 音・聴覚。音風景や騒音などを地図にする
days.idea: 未検討・先行して企画を決める

en.meaning: Map sound, soundscapes, or noise.
en.idea: Plan an idea early so the work can be prepared in advance.

days.meaning: 電力・エネルギー、または力・権力・影響力
days.idea: パラグアイ：水力発電がつなぐ国境。発電所・電力のつながり。候補、データ要調査

en.meaning: Explore energy, electricity, strength, or influence.
en.idea: Candidate: hydropower across Paraguay’s borders. Explore power plants and electricity connections. Data availability still needs investigation.

days.meaning: 物事の相互作用、または操作できる地図
days.idea: 追加候補。LINKS「町くらべ」を発展させ、自治体選択に地図・特徴グラフ・類似地域が連動する。類似は掲載物件の属性によるもので、地理的近接を意味しない。未採用。

en.meaning: Map interactions, or create an interactive map.
en.idea: Candidate: extend LINKS Town Comparison with linked maps, feature charts, and similar municipalities. Similarity describes listing attributes, not geographic proximity. Not yet selected.

days.meaning: 領土と同じ大きさの地図が着想。詳細さを極め、地図と現実の境界を考える
days.idea: 未検討・先行して企画を決める

en.meaning: Explore a map so detailed that it becomes the territory.
en.idea: Plan an idea early so the work can be prepared in advance.

days.meaning: 内外・上下などを反転し、普段の見方をひっくり返す
days.idea: 未検討

en.meaning: Turn a familiar view inside out or upside down.
en.idea: An idea has not been selected yet.

days.meaning: 人と共同制作する。AIは共同制作者に数えない
days.idea: 未検討。共同制作する相手も必要

en.meaning: Make a map with another person. AI does not count as a collaborator.
en.idea: An idea has not been selected yet. A human collaborator will also be needed.

days.meaning: 光と影、明暗を使って表現する
days.idea: 追加候補。LINKSの空域リスク・災害即応データから、夜間飛行を含む計画の割合を暗い地図上の光として表現。実飛行の明かり・夜景ではない。計数単位と分母を確認する。未採用。

en.meaning: Use light, shadow, and contrast to tell a geographic story.
en.idea: Candidate: show the share of drone flight plans that include night operations as lights on a dark map. These represent plans, not actual flights or nighttime scenery. Counting units and denominators need verification.

days.meaning: 公式説明は空欄。欠損・不在・空白などの解釈も可能
days.idea: 未検討

en.meaning: The official description is blank. Explore absence, missing data, or your own interpretation.
en.idea: An idea has not been selected yet.

days.meaning: におい・嗅覚で感じるものを地図にする
days.idea: 未検討

en.meaning: Map smells and the places we experience them.
en.idea: An idea has not been selected yet.

days.meaning: 六角形を使う。六角形メッシュでの集計など
days.idea: 追加候補。LINKS「混雑可視化」の現在の矩形グリッドをH3へ変更し、解像度による集中の見え方を比較。元データの位置粒度と既存集計で失われた情報を確認し、細かい六角形が高精度な飛行位置を意味する表示を避ける。未採用。

en.meaning: Explore hexagons and hexagonal spatial aggregation.
en.idea: Candidate: replace the rectangular grid in the LINKS congestion map with H3, and compare patterns at different resolutions. Check the source’s location precision and avoid implying finer positional accuracy.

days.meaning: OSMデータで地図を作る、またはOSMを編集する
days.idea: 未検討

en.meaning: Make a map with OpenStreetMap, or contribute to OSM.
en.idea: An idea has not been selected yet.

days.meaning: 地球を平面に表す投影法。その違いや歪みを扱う
days.idea: 未検討

en.meaning: Explore the ways we represent a globe on a flat surface.
en.idea: An idea has not been selected yet.

days.meaning: 味覚。食べ物・飲み物などを描く
days.idea: 公開データで再検討。「テレレと食の旅」は個人記録を前提とする案として外した

en.meaning: Map food, drinks, or other things we taste.
en.idea: Reconsider the topic using open data. The earlier tereré and food-travel idea was dropped because it depended on personal travel records.

days.meaning: 道路・交通・人間関係などのネットワークを描く
days.idea: 追加候補「空き家でつながる日本」。LINKS「町くらべ」のコサイン類似度を使い、掲載物件の特徴が似た自治体を線で結ぶ。地理上の距離と属性の近さを対比。交通・交流の実績を表す線ではない。未採用。

en.meaning: Explore transport, social connections, or another kind of network.
en.idea: Candidate: connect municipalities with similar vacant-property listing characteristics using LINKS cosine similarity. Contrast attribute similarity with geographic distance; lines do not represent actual transport or exchanges.

days.meaning: アートやデータ表現との境界を探り、どこまでが地図かを問う
days.idea: 追加候補。LINKS空き家データ基盤・町くらべを利用し、自治体を緯度経度ではなく掲載物件の特徴の類似性で配置する。通常の地理地図との切替で「何を近さと呼ぶか」を問う。未採用。

en.meaning: Explore the boundary between maps, art, and data visualization.
en.idea: Candidate: position municipalities by similarities in property listings rather than latitude and longitude. Switch to a geographic map to explore what “near” means. Not yet selected.

days.meaning: 河川・湖・海・流域など、水を扱う
days.idea: パラグアイ：行政界ではなく流域で見る国。SIAGUAPYの川・流域・湿地など。候補

en.meaning: Map rivers, lakes, oceans, wetlands, or watersheds.
en.idea: Candidate: view Paraguay through watersheds rather than administrative boundaries, using SIAGUAPY rivers, catchments, and wetlands.

days.meaning: 新しいツールを制作に取り入れて学ぶ
days.idea: 追加候補。LINKS空き家の正規化JSONをParquet化し、DuckDB-WasmやPorqueで地域を検索・可視化する。新しく試す技術を明確にする。物件座標は元データにないため、GeoParquetを使う場合は別途用意する自治体ジオメトリの粒度を明示。Porque自体の日への割当は未確定。

en.meaning: Learn by introducing a new tool into your mapping workflow.
en.idea: Candidate: convert normalized LINKS housing JSON to Parquet, then explore regions with DuckDB-Wasm or Porque. Source listings have no property coordinates; any added geometry must clearly represent municipalities. Porque has not been assigned to this day.

days.meaning: 感情や感覚など、抽象的な感じることを地図にする
days.idea: 公開データで再検討。旅の記憶案は外した

en.meaning: Explore feelings and other abstract sensations.
en.idea: Reconsider the topic using open data. The earlier personal travel-memory idea was dropped.

days.meaning: ピクセルで表現する。衛星画像・標高・土地被覆など
days.idea: パラグアイ：森と農地の時間旅行。MapBiomasの年代比較・変化抽出。候補

en.meaning: Work with pixels: imagery, elevation, land cover, and more.
en.idea: Candidate: explore forests and farmland in Paraguay through MapBiomas time series and land-cover changes.

days.meaning: パソコンを閉じ、紙とペンで地図を作る
days.idea: 未検討

en.meaning: Step away from the computer and make a map with pen and paper.
en.idea: An idea has not been selected yet.
